image_description: A white baby bib lying flat on a beige textured fabric surface. The bib features a terry cloth upper section and a cross-stitch style lower panel with the name 'LUCIA' embroidered in green thread. It has white binding around the edges and long white ties extending from the neck area.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and distinguish it from similar apparel like aprons or smocks.
To verify the legibility and structural integrity of the embroidered text, a common failure point in AI generation.
To ensure the ties connect logically to the body and the binding forms a continuous, unbroken loop.
To analyze the consistency of the terry cloth loops and cross-stitch patterns for signs of AI smearing or repetition artifacts.

focus_areas: Texture consistency (terry cloth vs smooth fabric)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the embroidery. AI often fails to render text that looks like stitched thread, resulting in floating letters or melted fonts. Verify if the 'LUCIA' text follows the perspective of the bib and if the thread texture is distinct from the background fabric.
